'''''The Last Lake''''' was an art piece depicting an empty sandrock basin on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was created as an [[Imagist gleamink]] sculpture and was displayed alongside other refined sculptures portraying Tatooine landscapes during an auction held at [[Mawbo's Performance Hall]].<ref name="TG" />
